### Walkthrough Non-streaming and streaming conversions now set `stop_reason` to `tool_use` when the OpenAI finish reason is `stop` and tool-call blocks are present. Unit tests cover this mapping and other finish reasons. ### Changes **Tool-use stop reason mapping** |Layer / File(s)|Summary| |:---|:---| |**Non-streaming conversion and finish-reason coverage**
`src/any_llm/utils/messages_compat.py`, `tests/unit/test_messages_compat.py`|The non-streaming conversion sets `stop_reason` to `tool_use` for a `stop` finish reason when converted content contains a `ToolUseBlock`. Tests cover `tool_calls`, `stop`, `length` and `content_filter`.| |**Streaming conversion and chunk-order coverage**
`src/any_llm/utils/messages_compat.py`, `tests/unit/test_messages_compat.py`|The streaming conversion sets `stop_reason` to `tool_use` when the finish reason is `stop` and tool-call blocks exist. Tests cover the finish reason arriving with the tool-call chunk or in a later chunk after the tool block closes.| **Possibly related PRs** - [mozilla-ai/any-llm#1560](https://github.com/mozilla-ai/any-llm/pull/1560): Retains tool-call block indices after blocks close, which supports detecting earlier tool calls when a later chunk reports `stop`. - [mozilla-ai/any-llm#1504](https://github.com/mozilla-ai/any-llm/pull/1504): Changes the `finish_reason` contract used by the Messages conversion. - [mozilla-ai/any-llm#1563](https://github.com/mozilla-ai/any-llm/pull/1563): Changes an Ollama completion finish reason to `tool_calls` for streams that report `stop` after a tool call.
